tasks.title: Publish the push-workflow inventory for every changed component (gateway, chat worker, agent-worker image, frontend) with the guard decision per workflow
Guard agent-worker-image.yml: refuse unapproved assistant changes before the worker digest rollout
Remove the unconditional workflow_dispatch bypass: a dispatch must carry an approved revision for the target
Scope the unset-approval refusal to candidates that actually change assistant paths; unrelated hotfixes continue

Behavioural guard tests: dispatch without approval refused, unrelated change passes with no approval vars, agent-worker component protected paths, inventory lists every push workflow touching changed paths
Cursor binding excludes historyVersion so an append by the owner does not invalidate outstanding pages
Missing, forged or expired capability returns 401 (refresh/bootstrap) while resource lookups keep the non-enumerating 404
Paging continues across a concurrent owner append; 401 vs 404 distinction asserted; existing owner-path suites still pass
Owner-only share/revoke operation writes aclUserIds with current-membership and same-tenant checks; revocation takes effect on the next read
A1 shares with A2: A2 reads; A1 revokes: A2 404; B1 and non-member same-tenant users never read; non-owner cannot share; model-supplied owner headers ignored
Migration writes a durable quarantine report (record ids and reasons) and scans tables in pages instead of materialising them
Quarantine report lists seeded missing-owner and conflicting-owner ids with reasons; counts preserved across dry-run, apply and rerun; paged scan exercised
Worker chat-data client maps 429 to rate_limited with Retry-After and 5xx to unavailable; never invalid_request
Client error-class tests for 429 with Retry-After, 500, 503, and that denied/empty/partial stay distinct

Live worker constructs ChatDataClient from the workload token file and passes it to the context, memory, artifact and draft factories when ADP_CHAT_DATA_ENABLED=true; fails closed when enabled and misconfigured
Chat ScaledJob manifest carries the scoped-data switch (ADP_CHAT_DATA_ENABLED default false) and gateway strategy values documented for enablement
Factory wiring tests: enabled selects gateway ports for all four stores through the agent entry; disabled keeps the current stores; enabled without token or strategy throws before any model call
Live owner/cross-scope/revocation/download cases with issued sandbox credentials in the qualification target
